data.notes: September 2026 is unusually strong for NYC, with major outdoor festivals, arena pop residencies, and late-summer electronic bookings clustered across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and Randall’s Island.

events.title: Harry Styles: Together, Together
events.summary: Representative September date from Harry Styles’ 30-show Madison Square Garden run, with Jamie xx listed on the bill. MSG’s event page states the September 26, 2026 date and the broader Together, Together residency window.

events.title: Experts Only Festival NYC 2026
events.summary: John Summit’s Experts Only Festival returns to Randall’s Island Park for a two-day electronic event on September 19–20, 2026. The festival FAQ confirms John Summit curates and performs during the weekend.

events.title: All Things Go NYC 2026
events.summary: All Things Go returns to Forest Hills Stadium for a three-day NYC edition from September 25–27, 2026. The official page confirms the venue and dates, with the lineup still pending.

events.title: CBGB Festival 2026
events.summary: CBGB Festival is confirmed for September 26, 2026 at Under the K Bridge Park. The AXS listing names Morrissey, Patti Smith, Interpol, Sex Pistols featuring Frank Carter, Bikini Kill, Agnostic Front, Buzzcocks, Circle Jerks, Mannequin Pussy, and more.

events.title: Robyn: the sexistential tour
events.summary: Robyn brings the sexistential tour to Barclays Center on September 4, 2026, with Yaeji listed for that date. Barclays Center also lists a second September 10 performance with Romy.

events.title: fabric New York: Jeff Mills, Ben UFO, Helena Hauff, x3butterfly, Shvili + more TBA
events.summary: London club institution fabric links with ReSolute for its first New York audiovisual takeover, pairing Jeff Mills, Ben UFO, Helena Hauff and local/underground support in a large-scale Brooklyn setting.

events.title: Weezer: The Gathering
events.summary: Weezer brings WEEZER: The Gathering to Barclays Center on September 30, 2026. The Barclays Center listing confirms The Shins and Silversun Pickups as support.

events.title: Teksupport: Four Tet
events.summary: Teksupport presents Four Tet at Brooklyn Storehouse on September 17, 2026. Resident Advisor confirms the 10 PM–4 AM event, venue, promoter, and Four Tet lineup listing.

events.title: Teksupport: Mau P
events.summary: Teksupport presents Mau P at Brooklyn Army Terminal on September 11, 2026. Resident Advisor confirms Mau P with Joseph Capriati and Quest, with a 3 PM–10 PM event window.

events.title: Black Coffee at Pacha New York
events.summary: Black Coffee brings a deep Afro-house and soulful electronic session to Pacha New York as part of a summer run, making this a major diaspora-rooted club event for the month.

events.title: ÄGAPĒ Festival 2026
events.summary: ÄGAPĒ Festival is confirmed for September 5–6, 2026 at Industry City in Brooklyn. The official page describes a two-day techno program across indoor and outdoor stages with 20 artists.

events.title: House Of Grooves: Eli Escobar All Night + Sissies Of Mercy
events.summary: Eli Escobar’s long-running NYC all-night House Of Grooves residency returns to House of Yes with Sissies Of Mercy in the Onyx Room, a strong local dance-floor institution rather than a mainstream concert booking.

events.title: Teksupport: Mau P (Friday)
events.summary: Teksupport brings Mau P, Joseph Capriati and Quest to Brooklyn Army Terminal for a large-format daytime techno/house event from one of NYC’s defining electronic promoters.

events.title: Liz Phair & Sleater-Kinney: The Flannel and The Fury 2026
events.summary: Liz Phair and Sleater-Kinney play a ticketed BRIC Celebrate Brooklyn! benefit concert on September 19, 2026. BRIC confirms doors at 6 PM and showtime at 7 PM at the Lena Horne Bandshell.

events.title: Ricardo Montaner: El Último Regreso Tour
events.summary: Ricardo Montaner brings El Último Regreso Tour to Radio City Music Hall on September 3, 2026. The MSG event page confirms the date, venue, and 8 PM showtime.

events.title: Sasha & John Digweed
events.summary: Sasha & John Digweed return to Knockdown Center’s Main Hall for a late-night progressive house/trance/techno session, a legacy club pairing still relevant to dance-music travelers.

events.title: Pat Metheny: Side-Eye III+
events.summary: Pat Metheny brings the Side-Eye III+ Tour to the Beacon Theatre on September 26, 2026. The official MSG listing confirms the 8 PM performance time.

events.title: VAULT presents: MAZ [Open to Close]
events.summary: VAULT brings Brazilian Afro/deep-house artist Maz for an open-to-close night in a members-club setting, framed as an intimate cultural escape rather than a standard club booking.

events.title: Nitefreak presents HiNDE
events.summary: Zimbabwean Afro-house artist Nitefreak brings his HiNDE cultural platform to 99 Scott, connecting African electronic sounds with NYC’s warehouse-adjacent club circuit.

events.title: The Nursery: Benji B, Nabihah Iqbal [DJ]
events.summary: Public Records’ Sunday Nursery series brings Benji B and Nabihah Iqbal for an afternoon/evening house session, a tasteful selector-led booking for travelers tracking NYC’s deeper club circuit.
